name: Doxa Coffee Roasters
notes: Coffee roaster on Monterey Oaks. Sits inside the Austin Oaks Church gym cluster.

name: Panera Bread
notes: Nearly even drive for both of us. Trader Joe's mural gym is right outside; two more in Treemont within a short walk.

name: Kerbey Lane Cafe - Southwest
notes: Its own sign is a gym. Arbor Trails gyms are a short walk south.

name: Kerbey Lane Cafe - South
notes: Wholly Cow gym sits right at the 80m edge - may need the right table.

name: Kerbey Lane Cafe - Westlake
notes: P. Terry's gym is 147m away, just out of range.

name: la Madeleine (Sunset Valley)
notes: French bakery-cafe. Brodie Tower is 91m away, just outside range; the three-gym Sunset Valley cluster is a 250m walk north.

name: Tacodeli (Slaughter)
notes: Breakfast tacos. Same center as Summer Moon, ~75m apart.

name: Phoebe's Diner - Shady Hollow
notes: Diner in Shady Hollow. Closest venue to your friend so far.

name: Magnolia Cafe (Oltorf)
notes: Austin diner institution, breakfast all day.

name: Snooze, an A.M. Eatery (Arbor Trails)
notes: Breakfast-focused. Sits inside the Arbor Trails gym cluster.
